primaryChecks.text: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.nextContext: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は対象名「Aram」を明記する。採用は地名用例に限り、正確な現代位置の確定を含まない。
